title: Measurement-Free Ancilla Recycling via Blind Reset: A Cross-Platform Study on Superconducting and Trapped-Ion Processors
summary: Ancilla reuse in repeated syndrome extraction couples reset quality to logical-cycle latency. We evaluate blind reset -- unitary-only recycling via scaled sequence replay -- on IQM Garnet, Rigetti Ankaa-3, and IonQ under matched seeds, sequence lengths, and shot budgets.
